script:
$env:Path = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path","User")
$configDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\opencode"
"=== opencode.json ==="
$config = Get-Content "$configDir\opencode.json" | ConvertFrom-Json
"Model: " + $config.model
"Plugins: " + ($config.plugin -join ", ")
"MCPs: " + (($config.mcp.PSObject.Properties.Name) -join ", ")
"Instructions: " + ($config.instructions -join ", ")
"=== global npm plugins ==="
npm list -g --depth=0 2>&1 | Select-String "opencode|skillful|dcp"
"=== skills ==="
Get-ChildItem "$configDir\skills" -Directory | Select-Object Name
"=== shell-strategy ==="
Test-Path "$configDir\plugin\shell-strategy\shell_strategy.md"
